title: National Noh Theatre
geometryBasis: Three named and identified native building outlines, the operator’s site record and exact public-domain street imagery.
sectionBasis: The original entrance photograph records the low, broad blue-gray pavilion roofs, pale panel walls, dark recessed porch, square pillars and hipped sections.
limitations: Standing principal auditorium and the mapped visitor-side ranges. Interior stage, freestanding landscaping and nearby non-theatre buildings are outside scope.
Height, rear fenestration and some connections are interpreted from the mapped plan and exterior photograph.
